CHORE-47 RED is complete. Branch: feat/env-migration, commit 53cd4fe.

What's in:
- client.spec.ts: replaced vi.stubEnv with vi.mock('$env/dynamic/private') mutable-object pattern. 2 tests RED: "uses ENTU_BASE_URL from $env/dynamic/private" and "uses ENTU_DB from $env/dynamic/private" — EntuClient implementation needs to read from $env/dynamic/private, not its current source.
- callback-page-server.spec.ts, login-page-server.spec.ts, server.spec.ts (auth): same pattern applied, all GREEN (implementations already use $env/dynamic/private).
- src/tests/deploy/no-process-env.spec.ts: new meta-spec, 4 tests, all GREEN — sources are already free of process.env. Acts as a regression net going forward.

Total: 2 RED (client.spec.ts), 401 GREEN.

Ready for Josquin GREEN: update src/lib/server/entu/client.ts to read ENTU_BASE_URL and ENTU_DB from $env/dynamic/private instead of its current env source.
